DFO salmon: a tributaries-only ROW on a parent that already has its own row. It binds the MAINSTEM item (Somass River, gnis:25707, wsc 930-139262, MU 1-7) — the tributary-only scope is a fact about the RULES, expressed on the entry, not about which water the row is. Deliberately NOT a name_variants entry: 'Somass River Tributaries' is a row label, not a name for the water, and making it searchable would put a non-name into the gazetteer. The row's single locator is whole_water with no anchors, so no split is needed.

DFO salmon: one row, TWO registry items — Adam River (gnis:28136) and Eve River (gnis:31112), the Eve flowing into the Adam. DFO regulates them together (4 pink/day, Aug 25-Sep 30, FN0905) while the provincial synopsis regulates them apart, as 'ADAM RIVER (except Eve River)' and 'EVE RIVER' — different name strings, so this cannot reach either row even before the source=dfo tag.

source_text.specific_area: that portion of the Somass River located approximately 200 meters above and 150 metres below the island near the boat launch at Somass Park near Service Road.

notes: SAME REACH as the live Somass Park locator, reworded — curator-confirmed. DFO described it in 2023-24 as '200 m above and 150 m below the island near the boat launch', and from 2024 on as 'from the northern boundary of Somass Park downstream to the southern boundary'. Measured: the island wording (curator pins 49.286879/-124.868498 top, 49.284243/-124.867080 bottom, 4 m and 11 m off the centreline) gives 7,024.0..7,685.5 = 661 m; the park wording gives 7,136.8..7,799.5 = 663 m. Two metres apart in length, offset a consistent ~113 m at both ends. Bound to the PARK cuts rather than minting a near-duplicate pair: DFO's '200 m / 150 m' is approximate and the reach is the same water.
